title: Municipal asset, service-request and native target receiving

task.name: Receive and operate a complete municipal asset project
task.purpose: Give the implementation partner and customer engineer one usable route from original asset/GIS/service-request editions through explicit mapping and named reconciliation to actual native target results and independent editable receiving.
task.request: Select the original customer Workshare, actual asset population, target system, named reviewers and complete receiving task. Install the same original municipal application and Grant Operations workspace. Receive the complete stopped handover with its original managed identity, project revisions, every source input, mapping, named review, request result and source-operation sidecar. Explicitly include or exclude every original project by exact revision and snapshot identity. Preserve original typed values, source-qualified IDs, null/absence, geometry and business-identifier duplicates. Review actual mappings, exclusions and repairs in the municipal project. When service requests are selected, receive their original full Open311 collection, review an exact asset association and optional existing work order, and retain observed native statuses. When a target is selected, use its actual file or Maximo schema and compound keys, full original captures, explicit source linkage, source-bound load and original per-item responses. Refresh public sources or acquire a later target only through their retained original operation. Bind the complete archive and selected-project document to the same original Installation source records. Preserve the full Workshare phases, effort, funding and original outcomes. Independently receive both complete working applications and saved Installation, rebind the original private runtime, operate desktop/narrow controls and reopen every complete output.
task.completeOutput: One complete selected asset project with original source/mapping editions, named reconciliation and work-order decisions, retained native results and all private source-operation history; complete report and editable stopped handover; same original Installation/Workshare, installed source/runtime and independently reopened customer workspaces.
task.repeatTrigger: A real new source edition, changed authorized asset population, later service-request collection, actual target revision or agreed operating period creates useful following work. Replay, receiving recovery and another report format continue their original operation.
task.pricedUnit: One agreed whole asset-source/target receiving or recurring source-edition task. Select the actual merchant-priced unit and whole-task atomic budget in the original case; preserve professional engineering fees and phase effort in the existing Workshare.

source.reference: The exact whole original municipal stopped-handover ZIP and managed workspace identity; every explicitly selected project revision and complete source/history fingerprint; original commercial Workshare and approved input/target scope.
source.population: All original projects and their source/target asset, location, request and work-order inputs. Preserve every included or excluded project and all its original source editions in the whole archive. The selected-project document defines the actual customer scope without deleting the other retained projects.
source.meaning: Source-qualified identities, repeated business IDs, original types and nulls, geometry coordinate reference, selected mappings, source/target snapshots, native statuses and observed times remain explicit. Open311 collections and public GIS captures retain observation semantics. Named local relationships do not overwrite original request or target state.
source.changePolicy: Later source or mapping creates a distinct reviewed edition. Continue original request IDs after uncertain replies, retain the first result and inspect actual original state. Changed source bindings make earlier service associations stale. Record permitted new reviews in the current project and actual changed commercial scope through the original Installation draft.

receiving.application: Existing municipal-assets Applications provider and original Python/SQLite operator, delivered alongside the existing Grant Operations Installation/Workshare application through the municipal-installation source selection.
receiving.acceptanceRule: The complete archive and selected-project JSON must be attached byte-for-byte to the original Operations case and matching Workshare seed. Preparation retains original phases, effort, assignments and observations. The saved Installation uses its native preview/save revision and original actor. Receive the full original municipal archive through its own portable receiver and independently import the complete Installation case; reopen selected historic project revisions and every original input/operation result while preserving later valid recipient edits.
receiving.changeAndWithdraw: The customer source and target owners retain their original authority. The operator reviews mappings, exclusions, repairs, service links and work-order changes in the same native project. Target load execution requires actual configured platform authority; original outputs and failures remain visible. Withdraw or change source and customer scope through their original application records.
receiving.recovery: Preserve original input archive bytes, project and case IDs, selected revisions, prepared source and the same receiving directories. A completed replay uses original native markers and request IDs. Missing external staging files can be recovered from the retained complete preparation. Later recipient reviews remain in the same independent workspace. Stop the municipal listener and external acquisition workers before its whole stopped-handover snapshot and receiving comparison.
receiving.maintenance: Name the original project/source owner, target operator, relationship prime, implementation engineer and independent receiver. Deliver complete source/runtime, private working archives, readable source report, original guides and agreed support. Password values remain host-local; independent municipal receiving creates its own original private password. Exact external messages and attachments require the owner’s current green.

steps.title: Receive original commercial scope
steps.result: Open the current original Installation or obtain the native fresh Workshare seed. Retain original phases, prices, effort, source authority, acceptance and funded assignments.

steps.title: Install both existing applications
steps.result: Build/receive the municipal-installation distribution. Open the original municipal project and Grant Operations case through their existing Applications providers.

steps.title: Retain the complete original edition
steps.result: Stop the selected municipal listener and external workers, then use the original handover command and operation. Preserve the whole ZIP, managed identity, database and every source-operation sidecar.

steps.title: Select the entire project scope
steps.result: Inspect the native archive, explicitly include/exclude all original projects with reasons, and attach the exact selected-project document to the original case. Obtain a fresh matching case and seed after those attachments.

steps.title: Prepare and save the original Installation
steps.result: Use the full preparer and readable source report. Inspect unchanged commercial checks/funding, complete source attachments and real deployments/payment selections. Preview and save through the original Installation writer.

steps.title: Operate original source and native target
steps.result: Use the current municipal mappings, named asset/service associations, work orders, public refresh and optional actual Maximo target. Retain original request/result and observed source semantics.

steps.title: Record actual customer acceptance
steps.result: Apply the original phase criteria to actual full outputs and named observations. Preserve unresolved differences and source lineage. Retain any paid purchases and engineering work under their own native records.

steps.title: Receive both complete workspaces
steps.result: Run the original two-workspace receiving course using actual saved Installation ID/revision, full archive and distinct private destinations. Reopen source, mappings, histories and original Workshare.

steps.title: Continue later work safely
steps.result: Make a permitted actual later recipient review, save/reopen it, then replay the same receiving to confirm that the later work survives. A genuinely new useful edition remains a distinct source selection.

steps.title: Inspect the outgoing customer experience
steps.result: Personally open/look/use the exact desktop/narrow apps and full source report, all meaningful controls and states, complete downloads, usable ZIP contents and every applicable PDF page. Repair concrete defects and reopen the actual saved files.

inputs: Original complete customer Workshare commissioning source and matching source packet; same Operations case and pinned plan.
Complete original stopped municipal handover ZIP and original source/runtime selection, with unchanged project IDs, revisions, input bytes and operation history.
Explicit full project inclusion/exclusion choices and reason; exact native revision and snapshot SHA for every original project.
Actual source rights and target authority; original asset/GIS/service-request inputs, native target schema, identity mappings and observed results.
Current complete Operations show result, same-version fresh Workshare seed, actual source attachment IDs and complete project-selection document.
Actual accountable merchant/buyer deployments, payment terms, total task budget and separate agreed professional fees.
Original private municipal and Operations workspaces plus distinct receiving directories, Python 3.11+ and the maintained installed Node/runtime dependencies.
Existing native case source limits: 8 MiB per original attachment, 24 MiB total and 200 files. Preserve the whole original archive; never substitute a summary for an oversized complete source.
Actual source report, full handover, saved Installation, independent reopen result and personally viewed desktop/narrow/output inspections.
